docs.text:
Krishnaswami Aiyangar’s selection of the sources for the history of Vijayanagara, the inscriptions, the Sanskrit and Telugu works and the accounts of the foreign travellers (Madras, 1919). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Sources of Vijayanagar history · Krishnaswami Aiyangar, Sakkottai, 1871-1947 · 1919, 422 scanned pages. Published 1919; Sakkottai Krishnaswami Aiyangar died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
